auditTitle: Omeetso Complete Project Discovery and Frontend Audit

applications.name: User Frontend Portal
applications.framework: React 19 + TanStack Router + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4

applications.name: Admin Portal
applications.framework: React 18 + React Router v6 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3

keyFindings: Zero backend server, database, or API calls exist across the codebase.
User Portal and Admin Portal operate in total isolation with separate localStorage keys and no data synchronization.
Development authentication bypass automatically grants Super Admin access when accessing the admin portal.
Image uploads generate transient browser blob: object URLs that break upon page reload.
All authentication flows (OTP, 2FA, social login) are client-side simulations using hardcoded credentials.
